title: System Update
items: What is a patch in IBM Storage Virtualize?
A one-time update that is installed without disrupting I/O
Patch 是一次性的更新，安裝時不中斷 I/O，通常用於修正小錯誤或安全問題。
Besides fixing small errors or security issues, what can patches deliver?
New features such as Ransomware Threat Detection
Patch 也可提供新版功能，例如 Ransomware Threat Detection。
Where are patches installed in the GUI?
Patch 安裝位置為 Settings > System > System Update。
Which packages does Auto Update apply to?
Only patch-type packages, not full system updates
Auto Update 只適用 Patch 類型套件，不含完整系統更新。
Which options exist for the system-level auto update policy?
Auto Update, Auto Download, and None
System Level 可選 Auto Update、Auto Download 與 None；各項目另可選 Use System Setting。
What happens to subscribed patches after a software upgrade (including CCU)?
已訂閱的 Patch 在軟體升級 (含 CCU) 後仍保留。
What happens if an automatic patch installation fails?
Which command sets the global auto update policy?
以 `svctask chsystem -globalautoupdatepolicy` 設定全域原則。
During a system update, how are nodes updated?
One at a time, with the partner node in the I/O group handling I/O
Node 依序更新，每個 Node 重新啟動時由同一 I/O Group 的 Partner Node 處理 I/O。
When is the new code level committed?
所有 Node 重新啟動後自動 Commit 新版本。
What is updated automatically after the commit?
Enclosure hardware components and drive firmware
Commit 後自動更新 Enclosure 硬體元件與 Drive Firmware，同樣不中斷。
Which tool checks the upgrade path before updating?
更新前須執行 Upgrade Test Utility 檢查升級路徑並驗證已知問題。
Which version of the Software Upgrade Test Utility should be used?
The version matching the current code
務必使用最新版的 Software Upgrade Test Utility。
What must be done with event log errors before updating?
Resolve them with fix procedures and mark them as fixed
更新前所有 Event Log 錯誤需依 Fix Procedure 處理並標示為已修正。
What should be verified on hosts before an update?
Multipathing drivers are supported versions and correctly configured
Hosts are in a host cluster
確認 Host Multipathing Driver 為支援版本且設定正確，以免 Node 重新啟動時失去存取。
For systems whose nodes have been online for more than six months, what should be considered before updating?
Node 上線超過六個月的舊系統，更新前考慮完整重新啟動。
Are management actions restricted during an update?
Yes, some management actions are restricted
更新期間部分管理動作受限。
When is a manual update through the service assistant typically used?
When a problem occurs during an automatic concurrent code update
Service Assistant Manual Update 用於自動 CCU 中途發生問題時，使用者直接控制個別 Node 的移除與更新。
How many nodes are updated at a time in a service assistant manual update?
Service Assistant Manual Update 一次只更新一個 Node。
Why must the service assistant manual update be used carefully?
It requires a reboot of all nodes at once
此方式移除了部分檢查，須謹慎使用。
When is the code committed during a service assistant manual update?
When the configuration node is removed last, the remaining nodes commit automatically
最後移除 Configuration Node 時，其餘 Node 自動 Commit。
Which CLI command can start a manual update?
CLI 可用 `applysoftware -prepare` 啟動手動更新。
What does every system update package contain regarding drives?
每個系統更新套件都含所有支援 Drive 的 Firmware。
After a successful update, which drives automatically receive the firmware?
Drives with use type candidate, spare, or member
更新成功後自動套用到 Use Type 為 candidate、spare 或 member 的 Drive。
In which situations is drive firmware also applied?
When new drives are added, failed drives are replaced, or applydrivesoftware is run
新 Drive 加入、更換故障 Drive 或執行 `applydrivesoftware` 時也會套用。
Where in the GUI can you update selected drives with a drive package?
可使用 Drive Package，在 Pools > Internal Storage 選擇 Drive 更新。
What does the main product software package contain?
A full software image including FCM drive code
Main Product Software 為完整軟體映像，內含 FCM Drive Code；其他類型 Drive 須用 Drive Bundle。
What does the drive bundle contain?
The latest firmware for all supported drives
Drive Bundle 包含所有支援 Drive 的最新 Firmware。
所有更新套件皆由 IBM FixCentral 提供。
Which patches can be obtained directly from FixCentral?
Generally Available Patches 可直接從 FixCentral 取得；其他 Patch 沒有直接下載連結時無法取得。
When is the Software Upgrade Test Utility included automatically?
When downloading the main software or drive bundle
下載主要軟體或 Drive Bundle 時會一併包含 Upgrade Test Utility。
What should be confirmed about Call Home before an update?
Call Home connectivity and network settings are correct
更新前確認 Call Home 連線與網路設定正確。
Why does the partner node handle I/O during an update?
So that host access continues while each node restarts
每個 Node 重新啟動時由 Partner Node 處理 I/O，讓 Host 存取不中斷。
Which option at the per-item level lets an item follow the system-wide auto update policy?
各項目層級除 Auto Update、Auto Download、None 外，另可選 Use System Setting。
What does the Auto Download option do?
Downloads patches without installing them automatically
Auto Download 只自動下載 Patch，Auto Update 則會自動安裝。
Do drive firmware updates after commit disrupt I/O?
Commit 後的 Enclosure 與 Drive Firmware 更新同樣不中斷 I/O。
What is the correct order of a system update?
Nodes update in sequence, commit, then drive and enclosure firmware updates
Node 依序更新，全部完成後 Commit，再更新 Drive 與 Enclosure Firmware。
Can patches be installed without disrupting I/O?
Patch 可在不中斷 I/O 下安裝。
What happens when a new drive is added to the system?
Drive firmware from the installed package can be applied to it
It must be manually flashed by IBM
新 Drive 加入時也會套用 Drive Firmware。
For which purpose would you use applydrivesoftware?
Which component is NOT included in the main product software package?
Main Product Software 含 FCM Drive Code，其他類型 Drive 須用 Drive Bundle。
In V9.2.0, which software does the auto download feature support?
Software for the installed release only, not full software release packages
9.2.0 的 Auto Download 只支援目前已安裝 Release 的軟體，不支援完整軟體 Release 套件。
Which parts of the system can be updated without restarting the nodes?
Drive firmware, security patches, and RTD models
Drive Firmware、Security Patch 與 RTD Model 可在不重新啟動 Node 的情況下更新。
Which drives need a separate package instead of the main product software package?
多數系統 (含 NVMe Drive) 可用主要軟體套件完整更新，SAS Drive 則需另行更新。
What is the recommended configuration to ensure timely patch updates?
Set the system level to Auto Update and keep Use System Setting for each update
Set the system level to Auto Download only
建議系統層設為 Auto Update，並保留每個更新的 Use System Setting，讓 Patch 自動下載並安裝。
Who can configure system update settings?
只有具 Administrator 權限的使用者可設定系統更新。
What is required for auto download of software releases?
Call Home must be configured and active
Auto Download 需要 Call Home 已設定並運作。
Does automatic download of a software release install it?
No, an administrator must start the installation manually
Automatic Download 只下載軟體套件，不會安裝，需由管理者手動啟動安裝。
On the Releases tab, what does the state Test successful mean?
The upgrade test utility completed successfully and the system is eligible to be updated
The release is available but not downloaded
Test successful 表示 Upgrade Test Utility 成功完成，可按 Update system 開始安裝。
If the status is Update test failed, can warnings alone block the update?
Errors must be resolved; warnings do not necessarily prevent the update
必須解決所有錯誤才能繼續；警告需評估，不一定會阻擋更新。
